status.en: 28 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 100% more than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Merti.
status.nb: 28 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 100 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Merti.

summary.en: The Ethiopian prime minister has placed senior ministers in military training at a centre in Hurso while army drones have struck displaced persons camps in Amhara, killing civilians including children, and a separate drone strike in Tigray killed civilians collecting grain. Sudan has accused Ethiopia of supplying the RSF with arms and of using Assosa Airport as a launch base for RSF drones. Two attacks four days apart in Oromia killed 60 Orthodox Christians. The conflict continues amid the Fano insurgency in Amhara, which began in 2023 over the government's security reforms. 2,824 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den etiopiske statsministeren har satt seniorministere i militær trening på et senter i Hurso, mens hærdroner har angrepet flyktningleirer i Amhara og drept sivile, inkludert barn, og et separat droneangrep i Tigray drepte sivile som samlet korn. Sudan har anklaget Etiopia for å forsyne RSF-militsen med våpen og for å bruke Assosa lufthavn som avfyringsbase for RSF-droner. To angrep fire dager fra hverandre i Oromia drepte 60 ortodokse kristne. Konflikten fortsetter midt i Fano-opprøret i Amhara, som startet i 2023 over regjeringens sikkerhetsreformer. 2 824 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
